name: Dream & Sugar
source:
You are a recent art college graduate who dreams of becoming an independent artist with their very own art gallery installation. Reconnect with your college bestie Riley, hit it off with dashing musician Hugo, and befriend thoughtful author Bennett. You decide which relationships to pursue! Will you find love in unexpected places? Or maybe you'd like to take things slower and focus on Nora's art goals instead? The choice is up to you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一名艺术大学应届毕业生，梦想成为一名独立艺术家，拥有自己的艺术画廊装置。与你的大学好友莱利重新取得联系，与潇洒的音乐家雨果一拍即合，并与深思熟虑的作家贝内特成为朋友。你决定追求哪种关系！你会在意想不到的地方找到爱情吗？或者也许你想放慢速度，专注于诺拉的艺术目标？选择权在于你！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875990/]Steam[/url]]
